request.style: English, male solo vocal, warm baritone character, acoustic guitar, gentle strings, soft drums, piano, hopeful and contemplative mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lamech took two wives for himself
One was named Adah, the other Zillah
Adah gave birth to a son
His name was Jabal in the land

[Chorus]
He was the father of those who live in tents
And keep livestock under the open sky
Walking the paths that he had made
A nomadic life beginning to rise

[Verse]
In the line of Cain he stood
Part of a family growing wide
Jubal played the lyre and pipe
Tubal-Cain forged the bronze and iron

[Chorus]
He was the father of those who live in tents
And keep livestock under the open sky
Walking the paths that he had made
A nomadic life beginning to rise

[Bridge]
Before the flood the world was young
Cultural pioneers finding their way
Tents and flocks in the ancient days
Living out the promise of the land

[Outro]
Father of those who live in tents
Keeping the livestock through the years
